newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Spring/White Wheat - Spring bids up.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Spring/White Wheat - Spring bids up.

text.p: Dark northern spring wheat bids on Tuesday rose in line with higher MGE futures prices.
Dealers cited no movement in many parts of the Northern Plains states due to flooding conditions.

Railroad operations in the Dakotas and Minnesota were impeded on Tuesday by high water with some rail lines south of Minneapolis-St. Paul possibly being closed later this week, railroad officials said.
High water also prompted the U.S. Army Corps of Engineers to close two more locks on the upper Mississippi, a spokeswoman said.
But in Montana, several merchandisers noted a little bit of movement in spring and hard red winter wheat.
